title: Reject stale plan approvals with an expectedPlanRevision on approve
description: MoeCommandSender.approveTask(taskId) sends only the task id, and the daemon approve path (taskStore / WebSocketServer) checks status, not which plan revision the human saw. The JetBrains PlanReviewDialog builds DoD and steps once and rerenders only comments on later updates, so a newer submit_plan can be approved from a dialog still showing the old plan. Add a monotonically increasing plan revision to the task (bumped on every submit_plan), accept expectedPlanRevision on the approve command (WS message from the plugins and the MCP tool if one exists), reject with a structured error when it does not match the current revision, and make the JetBrains dialog either rerender the plan on a revision change or disable Approve with a 'plan changed — refresh' notice. VS Code: send the revision too (small). Source: roadmap 2026-09-10 §4 'Fix approval freshness'.
definitionOfDone: task.planRevision exists in docs/SCHEMA.md and is bumped by submit_plan (vitest)
Approve with a stale expectedPlanRevision returns a structured error and leaves the task in AWAITING_APPROVAL (vitest); approve without the field keeps working for old clients
JetBrains PlanReviewDialog sends expectedPlanRevision and cannot approve a plan it has not rendered (JUnit test on the dialog model or presenter)
VS Code approve command sends expectedPlanRevision
./gradlew test and daemon npm test green

If a prerequisite is unlanded, its contract is absent or rails still conflict, report_blocked with specific unmet ids instead of duplicating child work. Re-measure git status, note all foreign dirty paths (including generated initFiles, launcher and board records) in the step note and preserve them. Make a DoD-to-child-evidence checklist; keep each child regression intact. Load test-driven-development before tests. No full regression in this exploration step.

Error handling: every failed approval, malformed token, write failure and temporary-resource teardown must have an explicit tested refusal/cleanup path. Add test-first daemon integration coverage using the existing WebSocketServer/McpAdapter real-dispatch test pattern and disposable temporary projects, with CONTROL mode and actual state serialization. Have review client A retain revision N from a snapshot, submit a newer plan through MCP from client B, then approve N over APPROVE_TASK; assert exact -32002/PLAN_REVISION_MISMATCH, context task id and expected/current revision, persisted/current AWAITING_APPROVAL, unchanged approval timestamp/assignment/activity/events and no approval response. Refresh to N+1 and prove approval succeeds. Repeat with real amend_plan_step and WS UPDATE_TASK steps/DoD edits (both fields together increments once); equal sanitized edits/comments alone do not bump. Include identical full resubmit incrementing exactly once, reload preserving the counter and legacy record/omitted-token compatibility. Exercise UPDATE_TASK awaiting-to-working approval metadata as well as APPROVE_TASK, malformed present tokens, forged revision fields and a serialized stale race. Pin test assertions to observable refusal and state, not source order or a mock-only helper. Reuse child tests for individual boundaries rather than duplicating their entire matrix. Demonstrate a targeted red by reverting the relevant fence/bump only in an isolated scratch copy, never the shared checkout; preserve the exact regression/evidence and restore that scratch mutation before the final gate. Close WS clients/server, cancel test timers and remove only the test-owned temporary project in finally/afterEach on all OSes.

Complete the approval-freshness contract/docs sweep against delivered code. Keep docs/SCHEMA.md and docs/MCP_SERVER.md consistent on new-task revision 0, legacy missing-as-0, the safe-integer domain, exactly-one increment per full submission or actual sanitized steps/DoD mutation, persistence and error precedence; describe APPROVE_TASK plus UPDATE_TASK metadata location, current/mismatched/malformed/omitted-token behavior and the actual structured WS error shape. Explicitly state that no MCP approve_task exists and set_task_status/automatic approval policies are not silently changed. Add docs/PLAN_APPROVAL_FRESHNESS.md with a concise user-visible change note and deterministic reproduction checklist: open JetBrains review N, submit or amend steps/DoD to N+1 without comments changing, stale action disabled with reopen notice; reopen and review N+1; VS Code delayed N click never upgrades to unseen N+1, and only complete render advances its token. Include stale refusal/disconnected/render-failure recovery, same-revision comments, missing task, and non-awaiting status. Map all five original parent DoD items to delivered child tests plus the new integration case. Name the intentionally compatible omitted-token legacy board/detail/old-client routes and SPEED/TURBO automatic policy boundary so the docs do not promise universal approval fencing. If code/docs disagree, request a scoped amendment/replan or report a prerequisite defect; do not spread implementation edits across child-owned files.

Run the one final feature regression gate fresh after tests/docs are final. From repository root on Windows use exactly: cmd /d /c "npm --prefix packages/moe-daemon test && cd moe-jetbrains && gradlew.bat test && cd .. && npm --prefix moe-vscode test && npm --prefix moe-vscode run compile". On macOS/Linux the equivalent exact command is: npm --prefix packages/moe-daemon test && (cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test) && npm --prefix moe-vscode test && npm --prefix moe-vscode run compile. This executes all daemon Vitest, primary JetBrains JUnit, secondary VS Code node:test and TypeScript compile; require nonzero counts from each test suite and the new integration test being collected. Coordinate shared Gradle outputs via Moe's resource protocol if another build owns them; do not kill peer processes or clean shared caches. Record fresh command, exitCode and outputTail including suite counts for complete_task, plus focused red-on-old proof from each child. A failed command, uncollected test, missing SDK/build prerequisite or unrelated suite failure is an honest incomplete gate, not a passing partial result. Do not rebuild generated assets or broaden task ownership to make unrelated failures disappear.

Perform one final adversarial self-review over the six delivered child diffs and this integration/docs diff before completion. Use adversarial-self-review and verify counter never regresses or double-bumps; sanitized no-op versus changed bytes; every steps/DoD writer including amendment and WS; compare under real mutex before timer cancellation; no forged stamp/metadata persistence; explicit stale code and unchanged task state; null/negative/fractional/huge/reload input; missing-token compatibility without claimed universal coverage; JetBrains both parsers and action-time guard before comments debounce; VS Code actual rendered token across debounce/failed rendering; duplicate sends, disconnected/error recovery and disposal. Check cross-package numeric domain and packet/error fields match, the original DoD is fully mapped and no held-out/child tests were weakened. If review requires code changes, repeat the final gate on those final bytes before claiming success. Report every path actually created/modified via complete_step.modifiedFiles and do not attribute foreign WIP. Complete only through moe.complete_task with the recorded fresh verification evidence; leave QA its explicit checklist and stop for wrapper landing, never mark DONE yourself.

priorBlockedReason: Read-only daemon and both-client exploration found two planning constraints needing scope confirmation. (1) Even DoD-minimum coverage requires 14 client files plus daemon/schema/docs/tests, over 20 total and above submit_plan's hard 10-file limit. Proposed dependency slices: daemon durable revision contract; daemon approval CAS/WS errors; JetBrains model+wire; JetBrains reviewed-dialog binding; VS Code model+wire; VS Code rendered-review binding; preserve this task as the final original-DoD integration gate. (2) Bumping only submit_plan does not fence all changes to the plan shown in a dialog: moe.amend_plan_step allows AWAITING_APPROVAL and WS UPDATE_TASK accepts implementationPlan/definitionOfDone. Need the human to confirm whether these in-place edits also increment the revision, or explicitly limit this card's promise to full resubmissions. Asked that question in the REPL; no confirmation received. Do not silently claim immutable plan-content freshness or remove legacy no-field compatibility. No plan submitted, code edited or tests/builds run. Detailed handoff to be saved in Serena.
